title: AC1 is contradictory
text: AC1 is contradictory: it requires every pass that reaches review execution to consider every category and emit an outcome for each, but lines 777–786 classify post-read terminal failures as reaching execution while permitting records only for categories reached. A mid-review failure cannot satisfy both rules. Define an atomic consideration boundary or explicitly exempt terminally failed passes from the every-category guarantee.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in 98f9dd6, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Spec PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews spec PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
